description: Default HttpClient-based implementation of ITempoReportServerClient. It applies an optional bearer token provider, serializes DTOs as JSON, and maps all Report Server API routes exposed by the F10 server.

constructor.signature: TempoReportServerClient(HttpClient httpClient, IReportServerTokenProvider? tokenProvider = null, string basePath = "api")
constructor.description: Creates a typed client for a report server base address. basePath defaults to api and is trimmed before route composition.
